lines.zh: 盔甲里没有身体，可它在走。
lines.en: There's no body in the armor, and it walks.

lines.zh: 我的铁鞋踩下去，声音很闷。
lines.en: My iron boot comes down with a dull clang.
Every step and the joints grind.
The plates clatter against each other.

lines.zh: 我走过的地上，留下黑印。
lines.en: I leave black prints where I walk.
I drag the sword behind me.

lines.zh: 我朝着还有人声的方向去。
lines.en: I go toward the sound of voices.
My helm is empty inside.
I can hear you talking.
I turn my head, and the iron grinds.
I stand. I'm very heavy.

lines.zh: 我从头盔的缝里往外看。
lines.en: I look out through the helm's slit.

lines.zh: 里面空空的，什么都没有。
lines.en: Inside is empty. Nothing at all.
There's a black film on my blade.
I've been grinding the blade a long while.
The iron cools slowly in the dark.
I hold a gauntlet before my visor.
That hand isn't mine.
But it obeys me.
I lower it slowly.
The armor is covered in scratches.
Each one belonged to someone else.
And I've added one more.
This armor gets thicker.

lines.zh: 我把剑在甲上敲了一下。
lines.en: I tap the sword against the plate.

lines.zh: 我把头盔朝暗处偏了偏。
lines.en: I tilt my helmet toward the dark.
You're looking at me. I don't mind.
There's no face in the helm.
You're looking for one. I know.
Don't look for a face in there.

lines.zh: 这身甲，是上一个穿它的人。
lines.en: This armor is the last one who wore it.
He couldn't take it off either.
Now I wear it for him.
Would you like to try it on?
Once it's on, it doesn't come off.
I raise the sword to show you.
Every notch in this blade was a person.
Your bones would be about the same.
The hilt turns inside my armor.
The iron dented. I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我的肩打歪了。
lines.en: That knocked my shoulder askew.
I raise a hand and bend it back.
The iron rings once, sharply.
The sword is still in my hand.
I raise it.
Something rattles inside the armor.
The rattling inside my armor pauses a beat.
The last one's.

lines.zh: 你举起来的东西，我不需要。
lines.en: What you raise, I don't need.
This armor isn't bought with money.
It wants people.
Put it down. Don't hold it to my visor.
Put it down and stand straight.
I don't like opponents who stoop.
You've backed to the forge.
Backed to the forge.
It's hot there. I don't much like heat.
But I'm coming anyway.
You hit the plates and bounce off.
My pauldron knocks you over.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的剑可能断了。
lines.en: Your blade may have snapped.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，铁响了很久。
lines.en: I step back and the iron rings on.
The armor's edge cut your hand.
I didn't mean that.
And I didn't stop.
The plates clatter as I turn back.
You're on the flagstones now.
I raise the sword slowly.

lines.zh: 这身甲里没有那样的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing like that inside this armor.
I remember before I put it on.
A woman waited in the doorway for me.
I didn't look back when I left.
Later I came back.
There was no one in the doorway.
Only this armor, hanging on the wall.
I put it on.
Now I'm the armor.
What you're saying, I can't understand anymore.
I bend and the plates jam against each other.
I pick up the broken sword.
This blade is no use anymore.
I drive it back into the ground.
I pick up a rag.
This rag is for the blade.
It won't take the black off.
I crumple it.
I let go and it falls.
I raise the sword and walk on.

lines.zh: 有人拖着剑，在石板那头。
lines.en: Someone drags a sword on the far side of the slabs.
I turn my helm that way.
That's iron on stone.
Another one. Also in armor.
He's in armor too. Let's test it.

lines.zh: 我的铁靴踩碎了一块铺石。
lines.en: My iron boot crunches a paving stone.
He's raised his blade.
I raise mine.
Our armor is the same.
Where did his armor come from?
His is exactly like mine.
I lower the sword.
He comes at me over the flagstones.
He's raised his blade high.
He's charging. Come on then.
I meet him. The iron rings.
He's circling to my flank.
I turn with him, slowly.
Iron joints don't do quick.
And I don't need to be quick.
I follow the sound of his plate.
He's gone behind a pillar.
Iron doesn't stop making noise.
I go round the pillar's other side.
His sword is held high.
That's an opening.
I'm in no hurry to bring the sword down.
Let him come down first.
The blade bites my shoulder.
The plate holds without a crack.
I shoulder him away.
He's fallen back, breathing hard.
The armor is heavier than its wearer.
He's slowing.
There's no one in this armour, only spite.
The hand in this armor doesn't shake.
No hand in this armor trembles.
A hollow shell, humming.
My iron boot moves one step in.
He raises his blade. Too late.
I bring the sword down.
His shield splits.
I ram with my armored shoulder.
He's knocked back several paces.
His sword bites my ribs.
It leaves only a white line.
I cut again.
His knees give and he kneels.
I raise the sword and pause.
The armor is pushing forward.
I didn't intend to cut.
But the hand has already come down.
It comes down very lightly.
I stand. There's wet on the blade.

lines.zh: 我从一副空甲里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of an empty suit of armor.
The plates close one by one.

lines.zh: 头盔扣下来，什么都看不见。
lines.en: The helm comes down and I see nothing.
And I hear very clearly.
This smithy is abandoned.
There are embers left in the forge.
I go over and put the blade in.
The forge fire has brought the blade to red.
I draw it out. The iron sings.
I know that sound well.
I lower the blade.
Then I raise my head.
Someone is standing in the doorway.
He's in armor too.
The same as mine.
I raise my blade again.
The armor starts walking.
I didn't tell it to.
And still it walks.
Then let it walk.
Fire heats the plate until the iron glows.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，甲片散了。
lines.en: I fall down the steps and plates scatter.

lines.zh: 水从缝里灌进来，我越来越重。
lines.en: Water pours through the seams and I grow heavier.
The blast buckles my breastplate.

lines.zh: 一枚子弹打在头盔上，凹了一块。
lines.en: A round dents my helm.

lines.zh: 咒语想把我从甲里赶出来。
lines.en: A spell tries to drive me out of the armor.

lines.zh: 甲要吃东西，可我没有嘴。
lines.en: The armor hungers, and I have no mouth.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，我全身都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the plate and I light up all over.
The armor sinks, and I go with it.
